title: RAW UNREVIEWED: position-sensitive spelling and cross-panel label reuse must preserve the same referent binding
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Combine the observed multi-base pX/yX paragraph-position contrast with independently inventoried label/prose string reuse and physical panel boundaries. Contrast a position-only rendering of one lexical item with a semantic change of reference. The decisive consequence is downstream reference identity across crossed position/owner conditions, not another paragraph-start classifier. No Voynich form receives a meaning.

design.mechanism: A workshop may reuse a labelled lexical item in prose but render it differently at the start of a written unit. Moving the same item between positions then changes spelling while leaving its referent and subsequent dependencies invariant. Alternatively the formal change introduces, resumes, or changes a referent; its downstream dependencies then follow the reference operation rather than merely the page position.
design.unit: Complete existing labelled panels and their complete prose records, retaining every exact whole form and every independently documented physical owner. Form-family relations and label/prose edges are separate inputs, never silently merged.

positive_inputs.fact: Seven supported ZL and eight IT pX/yX bases share the paragraph-position direction; this is descriptive and not a prefix meaning.
Ten exact label/prose string bridges and a corrected physical record/panel inventory exist. All ten bridges cross panel owners, so string reuse cannot itself identify the referenced object.

design.contrast: POSITION_ONLY: one lexical denotation and independently fixed record-position renderer; REFERENTIAL_CHANGE: a finite explicit owner-changing binder; ATOMIC: unrelated complete words with paid distinct entries. None may equate a string edge with a semantic reference.
design.prediction: For any independently nominated complete crossed case, POSITION_ONLY predicts the same eligible labelled referent and downstream dependency after the form change when physical referent evidence is unchanged. REFERENTIAL_CHANGE predicts a different downstream owner in the particular crossed cell specified before fit. Require a difference in an actually written later argument or label-bearing construction; position fractions alone cannot distinguish the models. A label-reuse edge passing across a panel is an opportunity to test identity, never proof of identity.
design.falsifier: Reject the specified position-only account if its mandatory same-referent consequence disagrees with an independently bound downstream argument; reject the specified binder if the owner switch it requires is absent in a complete eligible case. If the candidate accounts make identical written predictions, do not score or add hidden reference choices.
design.smallest_next_step: Use the existing GDT791 occurrence/owner metadata and GDT1073 full-form roster to nominate at most one complete crossed-case set, then write the three entire record-level dependency accounts before inspecting further contexts. Retain a zero-intersection outcome as lack of readiness, without substituting another family after viewing text. This bounded concrete authoring step precedes any implementation.
design.predecessors: GDT1099 has only one paragraph-head/reprise opportunity and contains reversed and medial p/y cases; no universal introduction/resumption interpretation is revived. IDEA17/26 and IDEA1 concern prior mention or boundary resets; this proposal requires a competing orthographic transport path and a downstream identity disagreement in the same complete crossed cases. IDEA883 concerns inter-hand spelling cycles, not image-reference identity. GDT791 quarantined aliases remain quarantined. IDEA12 explicitly warns that a positional opener can coexist with persistent topic; therefore ordinary topic coherence is not the discriminant here, only a frozen mandatory difference in independently bound downstream reference. Its missing endpoint gate is not claimed solved.
design.uncertainty: No overlap or independent target referent binding is asserted. Physical host ownership is weaker than semantic reference. The proposal may remain raw if its inputs do not intersect. Before any concrete lexical hypothesis retrieve global exact-form profiles, frequency/section dispersion and counterexamples. GDT1073 RF metadata stop and all GDT1099 cases remain. No all-reader pooling, new access, reserves or f84/f84r.
